text: The Prophet said: Allah says, 'I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him if he remembers Me.'
Whoever follows a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.
Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you.
Hadith Jibril: Iman is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and in divine decree.
Iman has over seventy branches, the highest of which is saying La ilaha illa Allah, and the lowest is removing harm from the road.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Whoever says La ilaha illa Allah and has in his heart the weight of a grain of faith will be brought out from the Fire.
The Prophet asked the slave girl: 'Where is Allah?' She said: 'Above the heaven.' He said: 'Free her, for she is a believer.'
